Frequently Asked Questions
What You Need to Know About SHL’s Personality Assessments
When can I use Personality Assessments?
You can use the OPQ, MQ and RWQ at any stage of the candidate journey, whether you are recruiting, developing or just want to better understand your workforce.
Are these personality tests available on mobile?
All our psychometric tests are designed with engaging, mobile-first technology, so candidates can easily initiate and complete them from anywhere and at any time.
What reports are available from these Personality Assessments?
SHL’s personality assessments offer a wide variety of automated reports, for both participants and managers, that are easy to read and understand.
What accessibility features are available for these personality tests?
Our personality assessments allow users to make color-contrast amendments, and there is guidance available for any candidates who may require or desire additional accessibility options.
How are these assessments administered?
All our psychometric tests are administered online. There is also an option to enable our remote proctoring capability, to administer the assessments within a virtually supervised environment.
